title: Maro Itoje Meets Mikel Arteta: Two Leaders, Two Mindsets, Two Champions
summary: Under Armour brought together England and Saracens rugby captain Maro Itoje and Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta in North London for an exclusive meeting between two champions exploring the mindset, resilience and leadership required to perform at the highest level.
body_markdown:
Under Armour brought together England and Saracens rugby captain Maro Itoje and Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta in North London for an exclusive meeting between two champions exploring the mindset, resilience and leadership required to perform at the highest level.


Despite competing in different sports, the pair have earned reputations as two of the most influential leaders in elite sport. With Maro recently achieving his 100th England cap and captaining the British & Irish Lions to an iconic victory, and Mikel recently delivering a historic league triumph as a manager, the biggest test of champions is how they prepare to go again.


The next challenge is always the biggest, and with Maro set to lead England at another Rugby World Cup, he and Mikel spent time on a basketball court and playing table tennis to delve into each other’s mindsets. Maro benefitted from Mikel’s experience of ending a long wait for silverware while Maro himself reflected on winning back-to-back trophies and discussing with Mikel what it takes to go again and regain the title.
